name: family-travel-editor
description: AI-assisted travel video editing in DaVinci Resolve: organize footage, plan family films, draft voiceover and apply timecoded feedback.

interface.displayName: Travel Video Editor for DaVinci Resolve
interface.longDescription: An independent AI-assisted skill for editing travel videos and family films in DaVinci Resolve. Organize camera and drone footage, reconstruct trip context, plan scenes, draft personal voiceover, check exports and apply timecoded review comments. Works with your local footage and Resolve; optional audio models and services are configured separately. Experimental: helper scripts support cataloguing and simple video-only XML timelines, not automatic finished films. Not affiliated with Blackmagic Design.
defaultPrompt: Help me edit my travel footage into a family film in DaVinci Resolve, starting with one scene.
Draft a personal travel voiceover from my confirmed memories and scene plan.
Apply my timecoded review comments to a new version of my DaVinci Resolve timeline.
